name: 🎀 Make Dresses
desc:
👗 CREATE YOUR OWN DRESS! ✨

Step into your very own fashion studio and turn your customers' ideas into beautiful outfits!

📏 MEASURE YOUR CUSTOMERS
Take accurate measurements for the bust, waist, hips, and more to create the perfect fit.

✂️ DESIGN & CREATE
Choose patterns, fabrics, colors, and styles to bring your designs to life.

🧵 CUT & SEW
Arrange your patterns, cut the fabric, pin your pieces, and carefully sew everything together.

🎀 CUSTOMIZE YOUR DRESSES
Add buttons, bows, lace, trims, and other decorations to make every outfit unique.

💰 COMPLETE ORDERS & EARN
Satisfy your customers, earn money, upgrade your studio, and unlock new fabrics, patterns, and decorations.

🏆 BUILD YOUR FASHION REPUTATION
Create stunning dresses, impress your clients, and become a legend!

Can you create the perfect dress for every customer? 💖

Inspired by Dressmaker

creator.name: Make A Dress x DT Studios

llm.loop: take customer order -> measure -> choose pattern/fabric -> cut and sew dress -> decorate -> earn money -> upgrade studio and unlock fabrics
llm.instructions: measure, design, cut, sew, decorate, complete orders
llm.thumbnails: mannequins with pattern UI, measuring tape
llm.complexity_notes: multi-step crafting UI and dress assembly system
